item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q014_paper_example_reclassification_pa1492","answer":"In SCOP 1.69, PA1492 (1t1j; d1t1ja_, SUNID 106249) belonged to its own fold c.137, superfamily c.137.1, and family c.137.1.1. Nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase (1f8y; d1f8ya_, SUNID 31395) belonged to the Flavodoxin-like fold c.23, N-deoxyribosyltransferase superfamily c.23.14, and family c.23.14.1. They shared only the alpha/beta class c; that classification did not recognize their homology.\n\nIn the current public SCOPe release, 2.08, PA1492 is classified as c.23.14.2: a separate PA1492 family within the same N-(deoxy)ribosyltransferase-like superfamily c.23.14 (SUNID 52309) and Flavodoxin-like fold c.23 as 1f8y, which remains in family c.23.14.1. Thus the change recognizes probable common ancestry at the superfamily level, while retaining distinct families. It does not establish that PA1492 has the same enzymatic activity or substrate specificity as 1f8y; such function transfer requires independent functional evidence. The current PA1492 domain SID is d1t1ja1 (A:1–118), retaining SUNID 106249 despite the SID change.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_service_info","mcp__scope__get_scop_domains","mcp__scope__get_scop_pdb_entry","/api/v1/releases/current","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1t1ja_","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1t1ja_/parents","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1f8ya_","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1f8ya_/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1t1j/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1/parents"]}]}
